items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

items.contentSnippet:
ig (Intent-Graph) is an a CLI tools to visualise your code architecture interactively. As I'm working heavily with AI coding and multiple project. ig helps to reduce cognitive load to have a visual way to view the code and diff. 
Just `ig init` on anycodebase then `ig analyse` then ìg view` you can have an interactive maps of you software architecture. Try it out `brew install mrzdevcore/tap/ig` and tell me your feedback. Thanks.

items.contentSnippet:

kernels in C and Accelerate. There is no R or Python runtime inside; everything runs locally,
and datasets never leave the machine.

items.title: Show HN: Stop applying to jobs using AI-generated resume
items.contentSnippet:

So recruiters are flagging such profiles and rejecting them entirely. I had tested this across 40+ AI models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, etc) to produce a resume and every single file carried a marker.
